instruction.name: vfrintrm.d
instruction.description: Round double-precision floating point elements in `a` to integers, rounding towards negative infinity, and store as floating point numbers.

experiments.name: dependent vector chain
experiments.notes: Vector registers initialised with normal 1.0/2.0 values, not byte-replicated integers. Measured with unroll=100000.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vfrintrm.d $vr0, $vr8; vfrintrm.d $vr1, $vr9; vfrintrm.d $vr2, $vr10; vfrintrm.d $vr3, $vr11; vfrintrm.d $vr4, $vr12; vfrintrm.d $vr5, $vr13; vfrintrm.d $vr6, $vr14; vfrintrm.d $vr7, $vr15
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --init 'li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; vreplgr2vr.d $vr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; vreplgr2vr.d $vr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; vreplgr2vr.d $vr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; vreplgr2vr.d $vr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; vreplgr2vr.d $vr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; vreplgr2vr.d $vr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; vreplgr2vr.d $vr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; vreplgr2vr.d $vr15, $r4' --asm 'vfrintrm.d $vr0, $vr8; vfrintrm.d $vr1, $vr9; vfrintrm.d $vr2, $vr10; vfrintrm.d $vr3, $vr11; vfrintrm.d $vr4, $vr12; vfrintrm.d $vr5, $vr13; vfrintrm.d $vr6, $vr14; vfrintrm.d $vr7, $vr15'
throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 3.99 cycles. Sources are normal float values.

notes: LSX vector floating-point instruction. Measured on LA664 with normal float operands; latency uses a dependent chain (unroll=100000), throughput uses 8 independent lanes (unroll=1000).
